## About

Pavan Sharma is a Computer Science undergraduate at Chandigarh University with a strong foundation in Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA), backend engineering, artificial intelligence, and machine learning. He specializes in building intelligent systems that translate raw data into actionable decisions and real-world solutions.

He has a research background (Fake News Detection — MMCITRE 2024), has earned AWS Solution Architect Associate certification, holds 54+ LinkedIn Learning certifications, and has interned at multiple companies in AI, backend, and frontend roles.
